## QNM overview
create a list of lists, so that each operating model scenario (0-5) 
has its own QNM list.
management strategies A/D use the same underlying QNM structure
but strategies B,C,E require their own unique QNM.

```{r load_models}
##### 0. A baseline scenario #####
mlist0 <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_00-constantF',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_00C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)

#### 2. Effort scales according to the Thorson effort model (Thorson et al., 2013) ####
mlist2 <- list(
  m2 <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_2-thorsonF',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m2.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_2C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)

#### 3. Climate reduces productivity ####
mlist3 <- mlist0

#### 4. Animals move into the “far offshore” area ####
mlist4 <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_004-movement-to-inaccessible',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_004C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)

#### 5. Climate increases growth rate ####
mlist5 <- list(
  m <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_005-growth-perturb',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]],  # no constraints
  m.c <- prepare.dia(dia_name='MSE-QNM_2023-Sep_005C-rm-small-mesh-redistribute-small',dia_path=here('data'))[[1]]  # no constraints
)


mlist_all <- list(mlist0,mlist2,mlist3,mlist4,mlist5)
names(mlist_all) <- c("OM O","OM 2 Thorson Effort","OM 3", "OM 4 Offshore Inaccessible","OM 5 Faster Growth")

```


## HCR Overview

These are the HCRs and the associated perturbations to the QNMs:

HCR A: Status Quo
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertA <-  c(`inshore small mesh effort`=0)
```

HCR B: Remove small mesh fleet
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertB <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1,`offshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

HCR C: Remove inshore small mesh fleet, allow effort redistribution to offshore small mesh fishery
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertC <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```

HCR D: Increase the mesh size for fishery #1
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertD <- c(`inshore mesh size`=1,`offshore mesh size`=1)
```

HCR E: remove fishery #1 from the inshore area
```{r echo=TRUE}
PertE <- c(`inshore small mesh effort`=-1)
```
